subject: prog-cont
title: PROG.CONT.-----TR.
description: Chart on book p. 282 (CMOA(II)-40). PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions), CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From CULT-INFO-DY: EXT-F (extended functionalism). From EXT-F: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and INFO-DE (information degrees). From INFO-DE: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: BSCF (basic scientific functionalism). PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from AFI.
